scene.ko: 동료에게 새 고객에게 보낼 영어 이메일을 봐 달라고 부탁한다.

lines.en: Hi, Olivia. Do you have a minute? I could use your help with something.
lines.ko: 올리비아 씨, 잠깐 시간 돼요? 좀 도와줬으면 하는 게 있어서요.
alt: Hi, Olivia. Are you busy? I was hoping you could help me with something.

lines.en: Sure, I've got a few minutes. What's up?
lines.ko: 그럼요, 몇 분 정도는 괜찮아요. 무슨 일이에요?

lines.en: I wrote an email to a new client, and I'm not sure if it sounds polite enough. Could you take a quick look at it?
lines.ko: 새 고객사에 보낼 이메일을 썼는데, 충분히 공손하게 들리는지 잘 모르겠어요. 잠깐 한번 봐 줄 수 있어요?
alt: I'm writing to a new client, and I'm worried it doesn't sound polite. Would you mind checking it?

lines.en: Of course. Send it over, and I'll read it after my one o'clock meeting.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 보내 주면 1시 회의 끝나고 읽어 볼게요.

lines.en: Thanks. I just sent it. I'd like to send it to the client by three, if possible.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 방금 보냈어요. 가능하면 3시까지는 고객사에 보내고 싶어요.
alt: Thank you. It's in your inbox now. I'm hoping to send it out by three.

lines.en: No problem. I'll get back to you before two.
That would be great. Please let me know if anything sounds unnatural.
lines.ko: 그러면 정말 좋겠어요. 어색한 부분이 있으면 알려 주세요.
alt: Perfect. Tell me if anything sounds strange.
Great. Let me know if any part sounds awkward.

lines.en: Will do. Oh, and maybe you could check the Korean on my slides sometime?
lines.ko: 그럴게요. 아, 그리고 언제 제 슬라이드에 있는 한국어 좀 봐 줄래요?

lines.en: Of course! Just let me know when. I owe you one.
lines.ko: 물론이죠! 언제든 말만 해요. 신세 졌어요.
alt: Sure, anytime. I owe you one.

expressions.en: I could use your help with ___.
expressions.note: 부탁을 부드럽게 꺼낼 때 · could use = ~이 있으면 좋겠다

expressions.en: Could you take a quick look at ___?
expressions.note: take a look = 한번 보다, 검토하다
